

// package main




fn main( ) -> (()) {
    
        

let rt = tokio::runtime::Builder::new_current_thread().build().unwrap();




rt.block_on(async {




let (tx, mut rx) = tokio::sync::mpsc::channel::<i32>(1);



let sent = (tx).send(5).await

;



sent.unwrap();



let value = (rx).recv().await

;



print!("{}", value.unwrap());




});



    
}
